# Units of Measure

Part of the **Support** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List UOMs

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms`

Retrieve a paginated list of UOMs for a specific category with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `uom_category_id` | integer | Yes | The UOM category ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: category, creator | `category` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[type]` | string | No | Filter by UOM type (reference, bigger, smaller) |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[trashed]` | string | No | Filter by trashed status. Available options: with, without, only |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms?include=category&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms?include=category&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms?include=category&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [

        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create UOM

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms`

Create a new UOM for a specific category

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `uom_category_id` | integer | Yes | The UOM category ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `type` | string | Yes | UOM type (reference, bigger, smaller). |
| `name` | string | Yes | UOM name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `factor` | number | Yes | Conversion factor. Must be at least 0. |
| `rounding` | number | Yes | Rounding precision. Must be at least 0. |
| `category_id` | integer | Yes | UOM category ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "type": "reference",
  "name": "Kilogram",
  "factor": 1,
  "rounding": 0.01,
  "category_id": 1
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "type": "reference",
  "name": "Kilogram",
  "factor": 1,
  "rounding": 0.01,
  "category_id": 1
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/support/uom-categories/{uom_category_id}/uoms', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'type' => 'reference',
    'name' => 'Kilogram',
    'factor' => 1,
    'rounding' => 0.01,
    'category_id' => 1,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

data = response.json()
print(data)
